claims.assertion: Anéeka says Taygeta has no money or formal economy, with needs met through abundance and household goods made by replicators.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says clean energy is mostly free and generated by zero-point pyramid reactors.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says the Taygetan First Contact project used the human Internet to introduce themselves and assess Earth's receptivity to direct contact.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: After the project ended in 2016, she studied Earth culture and supported shipboard information work.
